notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR2: 'Data-name-1 must be the name of a detail report group described in the same report as the control footing report group in which the SUM clause appears. Data-name-1 may be qualified by a report-name.' UponDetailRef screens the shape (no subscript or ref-mod, at most one qualifier) and ResolveUponDetail, called from ResolveReports, resolves the name through ReportGroupResolution.Resolve and refuses a non-group or a non-detail with COBOL2046 (the witness: UPON CFG). Probes at --std 85 (classes b, c, d): UPON DET, DET OF RPT, DET IN RPT and DET DET1B compile and total; UPON CFG, NOSUCH, DET OF RPT-FILE, DET(1), DET1B OF RPT2 and an empty UPON are refused. kb/Work PB5474 landed: below 2002 ResolveUponDetail resolves data-name-1 within the control footing's own report only (a report-name qualifier of another report names nothing there) and refuses a detail of ANOTHER report by name (COBOL2046; UPON DET2 OF RPT2 and the unqualified UPON DET2 from RPT's footing), while the 2002 and later cross-report trigger (kb/Work PB1294) is unchanged. Witnesses: pb5474_upon_own_report_detail (accepted, two reports), pb5474_upon_detail_of_another_report (refused).

next.reason: 1985: "must be the name of a detail report group described in the same report as the control footing report group in which the SUM clause appears"; 2023: "Data-name-2 shall be the name of a detail. It may be qualified only by a report-name.". The 1985 UPON operand is 2023 data-name-2. The 2023 rule no longer requires the detail to be in the same report, nor the SUM clause to be in a control footing.
